meta.description: Fails when an attested OSV report contains a vulnerability with an EPSS score at or above the threshold (default 0.5)
meta.name: Maximum EPSS Score

epssThreshold.description: EPSS score (0.0-1.0) at or above which a vulnerability fails the policy. Defaults to 0.5.

error.message: Attested OSV report contains vulnerabilities at or above the EPSS threshold: {{ .Outputs.likelyExploited }}
error.guidance: These vulnerabilities are likely to be exploited (high EPSS) — prioritize remediation, or raise the epssThreshold context value

assessment.message: Attested OSV report contains no vulnerabilities at or above the EPSS threshold
